## Checklist

- [ ] `make ci-docker` (or `make ci`) is green locally
- [ ] No credentials, state, kubeconfigs, real IDs or IP addresses (`make scan`)
- [ ] New pins are in `platform/versions.yaml` with a source and verified date
- [ ] Any new number has a method, exact versions and an evidence file
- [ ] Docs, runbooks and the CHANGELOG are updated where behaviour changed
